decisions.reason: s0001 reads 許州人; 許州 is Xu Prefecture (Xuchang region), not 徐州. Rendering it as Xuzhou invents the wrong place, and Xu Prefecture restores the source.
The literal likewise turns 許州 into Xuzhou; Xu Prefecture matches the Chinese place-name and avoids confusion with 徐州.
詔贈太尉 records a posthumous grant of 太尉 (Grand Commandant), not 太師 (Grand Preceptor); the proposed title is the correct office.
The literal also mistranslates 太尉 as Grand Preceptor; Grand Commandant is the accurate English for that title.

decisions.after: His father Jingrou had been prefect in turn of Ying, Ping, Ru, Tan, and a second Ying Prefecture.
decisions.reason: The source lists five prefectures 瀛、平、儒、檀、營; the first and last are distinct places both romanized Ying. Calling the latter a second Ying Prefecture preserves the distinction without inserting Chinese characters into the English text.
